scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix web"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix web
scripts.build: npm run install:all && npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix web
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && npm test --prefix web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix server && npm run typecheck --prefix web
